stories.story_fr: Johnson & Johnson a affiché une performance solide au troisième trimestre 2025, soutenue par la profondeur de son portefeuille et des progrès significatifs de son pipeline.
stories.story_en: Johnson & Johnson delivered a strong performance in Q3 2025, driven by portfolio depth and significant pipeline progress.
stories.quote: Johnson & Johnson delivered another strong performance in the third quarter fueled by the depth and strength of our portfolio and significant progress across our pipeline.

stories.story_fr: L'impact de Stelara a réduit les résultats de ~640 points de base.
stories.story_en: Stelara impacted results by approximately 640 basis points.
stories.quote: Stelara impacted results by ~(640) basis points

stories.story_fr: Le bénéfice ajusté par action a atteint 2,80 $ en hausse de 15,7 %.
stories.story_en: Adjusted diluted earnings per share rose to $2.80, up 15.7%.
stories.quote: Adjusted diluted earnings per share $2.80, up 15.7%

stories.story_fr: Résultats du troisième trimestre 2021 démontrent une performance solide grâce à des résultats supérieurs au marché dans les produits pharmaceutiques, une reprise des dispositifs médicaux et une forte croissance en santé grand public.
stories.story_en: Q3 2021 results show solid performance driven by above‑market pharmaceutical results, medical devices recovery, and strong consumer health growth.
stories.quote: robust above-market results in Pharmaceuticals, ongoing recovery in Medical Devices, and strong growth in Consumer Health

stories.story_fr: Alex Gorsky annonce son départ et la transition du poste de PDG à Joaquin Duato en janvier.
stories.story_en: Alex Gorsky announces his departure and the CEO transition to Joaquin Duato in January.
stories.quote: I am incredibly proud... as I prepare to transition the role of CEO to Joaquin Duato in January
